title: Mangrove Loss Slowed By 45%
hook: Mangrove Loss Slowed 45%, But Millions Of Hectares Vanished
closing: Slower loss proves protection works, but slowing is not the same as stopping.
question: Can mangroves recover?

segments.say: Mangrove forests shrank to 15.2 million hectares, stripping coastlines of natural storm protection.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves, the biggest regional share of the decline.
Annual mangrove loss slowed 45%, proving protection can bend the curve before remaining forests disappear.
